title: A tech story reading "Tech story missing." is left out of the report text
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is on.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A07 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A07 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} with Title (for example "Replace tie rod"), Description (for example "excessive play") and the tech story exactly "Tech story missing." (with the full stop).
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Click an empty cell, type =LEN( then click that ItemDescription cell, type ) and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the cell reads the title, " - ", then the description, and ends there (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play"). The words "Tech story missing." do not appear and there is no trailing hyphen or space.
  • Step 7: with the example values the number is 32, the same as a line with no tech story at all.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-R6, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (Awkward inputs), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-009; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R6: “A line with no narrative ends after the description, with no trailing hyphen and no trailing space. A narrative is absent when the value is empty, or when it is the literal placeholder "Tech story missing." that the line dialog writes when nothing was typed; the two are treated identically, and neither reaches QuickBooks.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a line whose narrative is the literal "Tech story missing.", then the text ends after the description exactly as if the narrative were empty.”
